title: Move active servicing to common tooling without hiding passive cost
statement: The new source uses56parts/136joins/43nets and32 qualifying submillimetre passives on eight passive seven-part leaves, with a proposed23.4x23.4x23.2mm permanent envelope. The1.8Mohm/120pF feedback and optical/thermal gates define a new operating case, not an overwrite of earlier parameter results. Two terminal fingers have separate functional A and normally floating diagnostic B roles. Actuators/metrology scale with service stations while passive routing, constraints and contacts still scale with parts/terminals; this is not a qualified manufacturing saving.
